name: stage_handtuned_proto_steps_v1
description: Hand-tuned via reward_panel during 2026-05-30 V10 post-mortem session. Operator-observed proto-stepping + dynamic standing (occasional falls) with no stable attractor lock-in over the visible window. Single-stage, no auto-advance — sustained in this regime for full run. Key shifts vs v9c_kneerel: reward_shape=trapezoid + peak fixed at 0.082 (kills the knee_relative low-peak self-reinforcement); reward_min_height=0.06 (excludes the y=0.055 tilted-prop attractor seen in V10); level_chassis_rate=0.05 (tilt now has a cost — was 0.0 throughout V10); standing_baseline_factor=0.20 (lowest standing dominance yet, so walk bonus can compete from t=0); walk_target_velocity=0.55 (aggressive, gradient never saturates at crawler speeds); gated_walk_bonus_rate=0.20 + phase_contrast_gain=0.9 ON from t=0 (no stage-gate; walk + diagonal-alternation incentive lives from the first tick).
